sentences.en: Juha sent his son to bring water.
Before he left, he slapped him.

sentences.ar: الجيران زعلوا: ليش ضربته وهو ما عمل إشي؟
sentences.en: The neighbours were upset: why did you hit him when he did nothing?

sentences.ar: قال جحا: لما تنكسر الجرة بتنكسر.
sentences.en: Juha said: when the jar breaks, it is broken.
And hitting after that is no use.
